hooks.name: guard
hooks.description: Runs on every PreToolUse event (no matcher). The script reads the tool name and arguments: shell tools (shell, execute_bash and similar) are checked for rm -rf in the repo or DATA_DIR, force pushes, reset --hard, clean -f and shell edits of protected paths; file-writing tools are blocked from .kiro/steering|settings|hooks|agents/**, .kiro/STOP and pipeline/tests/fixtures/expected_zombies.json (workflow-runs and tasks.md checkboxes stay allowed); unknown tools are allowed.
